10 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

The stories

  • Rochdale mum diagnosed with breast cancer after routine NHS screening Rochdale
    Sarah Hickman, 50, encourages women to attend NHS breast screenings after her cancer was detected early during a routine mammogram.
  • Road closures in Milnrow for Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026 Milnrow
    Milnrow will see temporary road closures on 8 November 2026 for Remembrance Sunday, as announced by Rochdale Borough Council.
  • Road closures in Norden for Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026 Norden
    Norden will see temporary road closures on 8 November 2026 for Remembrance Sunday, affecting Woodhouse Lane and surrounding areas.
  • Road closures for Middleton Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026 Middleton
    Temporary road closures will be in effect in Middleton for Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026, affecting local traffic and access.
  • Road closures for Heywood Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026 Heywood
    Heywood will host its Remembrance Sunday event on 8 November 2026, leading to road closures in the area.
  • Rochdale AFC welcomes local groups for No Room for Racism fixture Rochdale
    Young people and their families from BACP and Army of Kindness were invited to join Rochdale AFC as flag bearers for the club’s annual No Room for Racism fixture.
  • Volunteers brave rain to help Rochdale Sea Cadets at Hollingworth Lake Littleborough
    Rochdale Sea Cadets have thanked Get Together After Serving CIC after volunteers spent a wet morning clearing overgrowth around their boat shed at Hollingworth Lake.
  • Halifax Road roadworks in Hurstead set to begin on 26 October 2026 Rochdale
    Rochdale Borough Council has announced that roadworks on Halifax Road in Hurstead will begin at midnight on 26 October 2026 and are expected to continue until 1 November 2026.
  • Bridge Street in Heywood closed over fears wind could cause building to collapse Heywood
    Firefighters, police and Rochdale Council responded to concerns about a derelict building. The structure was still standing in the latest report.
  • Rochdale Council encourages reporting of concerns regarding HMOs Rochdale
    Residents are urged to report any issues with Houses in Multiple Occupation (HMOs) to ensure tenant safety and compliance with regulations.

Weather: Cloudy 11°C in Rochdale today.

body:
10 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

The stories:

Rochdale mum diagnosed with breast cancer after routine NHS screening (Rochdale). Sarah Hickman, 50, encourages women to attend NHS breast screenings after her cancer was detected early during a routine mammogram.

Road closures in Milnrow for Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026 (Milnrow). Milnrow will see temporary road closures on 8 November 2026 for Remembrance Sunday, as announced by Rochdale Borough Council.

Road closures in Norden for Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026 (Norden). Norden will see temporary road closures on 8 November 2026 for Remembrance Sunday, affecting Woodhouse Lane and surrounding areas.

Road closures for Middleton Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026 (Middleton). Temporary road closures will be in effect in Middleton for Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026, affecting local traffic and access.

Road closures for Heywood Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026 (Heywood). Heywood will host its Remembrance Sunday event on 8 November 2026, leading to road closures in the area.

Rochdale AFC welcomes local groups for No Room for Racism fixture (Rochdale). Young people and their families from BACP and Army of Kindness were invited to join Rochdale AFC as flag bearers for the club’s annual No Room for Racism fixture.

Volunteers brave rain to help Rochdale Sea Cadets at Hollingworth Lake (Littleborough). Rochdale Sea Cadets have thanked Get Together After Serving CIC after volunteers spent a wet morning clearing overgrowth around their boat shed at Hollingworth Lake.

Halifax Road roadworks in Hurstead set to begin on 26 October 2026 (Rochdale). Rochdale Borough Council has announced that roadworks on Halifax Road in Hurstead will begin at midnight on 26 October 2026 and are expected to continue until 1 November 2026.

Bridge Street in Heywood closed over fears wind could cause building to collapse (Heywood). Firefighters, police and Rochdale Council responded to concerns about a derelict building. The structure was still standing in the latest report.

Rochdale Council encourages reporting of concerns regarding HMOs (Rochdale). Residents are urged to report any issues with Houses in Multiple Occupation (HMOs) to ensure tenant safety and compliance with regulations.

Weather: Cloudy 11°C in Rochdale today.
